svg.title: FROST architecture
svg.desc: Three stages: offline granular-mask precomputation, CycleGAN-Turbo training with a mask-weighted structure loss, and mask-free one-step evaluation.
svg.text: Granular-computing masks shape the training objective only. Inference is the unchanged one-step CycleGAN-Turbo pass.
GPU · 2,000 steps per run · one run per method
same params for x and M
no masks · identical inference for all four methods
added by FROST; everything else is stock CycleGAN-Turbo
